mei/ex_t_play_pipa.text: Play the pipa. Left leg forward on the heel. Left hand forward at shoulder height, right hand by the elbow. As if holding a string instrument.

mei/ex_t_single_whip.text: Single whip. A small step to the left. Your left hand pushes forward. Your right hand extends to the side, fingers gathered and pointing down. Your eyes follow the left hand.

mei/ex_t_high_pat_horse.text: High pat on horse. Weight back. The left foot touches with the toes. Your right palm faces forward at face height. Your left hand below it, palm up.

mei/ex_t_strike_ears.text: Strike ears with both fists. A small step. Two loose fists rise in an arc to ear height. Elbows soft. No force.

mei/ex_t_shuttle.text: Fair lady works the shuttles. One hand above your forehead, palm facing out. The other hand pushes forward at chest height. Then the other side.
